task.title: Anti-self-approval + two-man for high-risk HumanGate + extend_ttl cap + revoke fail-closed
acceptance: HumanGate approve/reject/revoke return 403 when identity.operator_id equals the underlying approval requester_id
HumanGate items linked to high-risk downstream actions require twoManSignatureId at admission (catalog flag + executor honors)
HumanGateExtendTtl caps ttl_seconds at PANTHEON_HUMAN_GATE_MAX_TTL_SECONDS (default 604800 = 7 days) and returns 422 above cap
HumanGateRevoke returns 409 with compensating-action suggestion when downstream effect already executed
_normalize_human_gate_command treats cmd.target.id as authoritative — params.human_gate_item_id must equal target.id or admission returns 422
